title: Social Media Content Creator (Do Not Quick Apply)
description:
Brand Storyteller

(Full-Time Contractor · Remote · BestLyfe Group)

About the Role

BestLyfe Group (BLG) is on the hunt for a world-class Brand Storyteller — someone who lives and breathes content, strategy, and data. You’ll be the creative force behind the social presence of three powerhouse brands:

  • Dustin Lunde (our fearless founder)
  • Lyfe by the Horns (our unapologetically real podcast and brand)
  • BestLyfe Group (our marketing agency changing how businesses grow)

Your mission? Build authority, drive engagement, and make people feel something when they see our content. You’ll co-create strategy with leadership, manage execution across every platform, and bring the kind of creative energy that makes people stop scrolling and start following.

This isn’t a “post pretty graphics and call it a day” gig. This is brand building at its finest — story, psychology, timing, and metrics all rolled into one.

What You’ll Do
  • Develop and execute a holistic content strategy across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, X, and Threads
  • Collaborate directly with leadership to create high-impact content campaigns for BLG, LBTH, and Dustin’s personal brand
  • Edit short- and long-form videos, design graphics, and produce thumb-stopping creative assets
  • Write witty, on-brand copy that captures our tone — bold, self-aware, real
  • Analyze performance data and adjust strategy to improve engagement, reach, and conversion
  • Manage posting schedules and platform optimizations
  • Repurpose content across platforms to maximize visibility and ROI
  • Collaborate with our current editor during the transition period for consistent quality and brand cohesion
Who You Are
  • A creative weapon — equal parts strategist, designer, editor, and storyteller
  • Obsessed with social media trends, but smart enough to know when to lead instead of follow
  • Fluent in Canva, Adobe Suite, or CapCut, and capable of building content that looks as good as it performs
  • Analytical enough to make data sexy — and creative enough to turn insights into action
  • A self-starter who thrives in autonomy, takes initiative, and communicates like a pro
  • Hungry, curious, and coachable — talent and drive matter more to us than titles or years of experience
The BLG Culture (Read Carefully)

We’re not looking for average.

Average doesn’t last here.

BLG is a no-BS, high-performance culture built on creativity, accountability, and excellence. We don’t do drama, excuses, or clock-watchers. We do bold ideas, ownership, and growth.

If you love creating, want to be part of something that’s actually going somewhere, and thrive under leadership that challenges and believes in you — you’ll fit right in.

If you need hand-holding, constant direction, or approval for every idea — this isn’t your gig.

Why BLG

Because we’re building something real.

You’ll work directly with the founder, get exposure to multiple brands, and have the freedom to test, create, and evolve — all while being part of a team that’s redefining what marketing should feel like.

How to Apply

Think you’ve got what it takes? Prove it.

Click below and submit your VideoAsk with:

  • Your name and contact info.
  • Respond to 3 questions.

Submit Your VideoAsk Here

title: Lead SRE Engineer
description:
About the Company:

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


About the Role

We’re seeking an experienced Lead Site Reliability Engineer to join our growing team in Brazil. In this role, you’ll partner with product teams to tackle critical infrastructure challenges, acting as both a hands-on technical expert and a mentor.

You’ll help design, build, and operate cloud platforms while driving reliability, performance, and security across the engineering organization.


Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Guide and support engineers, foster technical excellence through code reviews and design discussions, and help unblock complex challenges.
  • Documentation & Standards: Create and maintain runbooks, standards, and best-practice guides to strengthen operational capabilities.
  • Infrastructure as Code & CI/CD: Automate provisioning and deployments using Terraform and best-practice pipelines (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, etc.).
  • Reliability Engineering: Define SLIs/SLOs, manage error budgets, and build dashboards and alerts to proactively monitor system health.
  • Security & Compliance: Enforce least-privilege IAM policies, automate vulnerability scans, and maintain audit logging.
  • Monitoring & Observability: Instrument services with metrics, logs, and distributed tracing to enable rapid troubleshooting.
  • Cost Optimization: Implement tagging strategies, right-size resources, and use data-driven insights to manage cloud spend effectively.


Must Have

  • Managing production-critical systems with deep knowledge of SRE and DevOps principles .
  • Proven experience mentoring engineers and leading technical projects.
  • Strong proficiency with AWS and cloud-native best practices.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS or GKE) and large-scale container orchestration.
  • Expertise with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning.
  • Experience managing and debugging Redis and Postgres databases.
  • Solid understanding of VPCs, VPNs, load balancers, and cloud networking .
  • Proficiency with Git , branching strategies, and CI/CD integrations.
  • Strong grasp of web and network protocols (HTTP, REST, TLS, DNS, etc.).


Nice to Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience breaking down large, ambiguous projects into actionable tasks.
  • Familiarity with ArgoCD , GitHub Actions , Jenkins , or similar CI/CD tools.
  • Working knowledge of Python , Golang , and Helm .
  • Experience running scalable Node.js microservices.
  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure security and Terragrunt best practices.
  • Background in production readiness and high-growth engineering environments .


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Cloud Data Engineer
description:

Salary range: Competitive and negotiable based on experience

The Senior Cloud Data Engineer leads the design, architecture, and implementation of secure, scalable data solutions on AWS, utilizing Snowflake, dbt, and modern automation tools. This role drives best practices for data quality, validation, and governance, while optimizing performance and reliability across both cloud and legacy platforms. The Senior Cloud Data Engineer collaborates closely with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into robust data pipelines and products, mentor junior engineers, and champions continuous improvement in engineering standards and operational excellence.


Key Responsibilities

  • Leads the design, development, and maintenance of highly scalable, secure, and resilient data pipelines and systems on cloud platforms.

  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, business analysts, product owners, and application engineers—to understand and deliver on evolving data requirements.

  • Monitors, optimizes, and scales data workflows to achieve performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency targets across both cloud and legacy environments.
  • Proactively identifies, investigates, and resolves data-related issues, providing technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior team members.
  • Champions continuous improvement by staying current with industry trends, emerging technologies, best practices, and by driving innovation in data engineering processes and solutions.
  • Partners with enterprise architecture and data governance teams to define and enforce data standards and compliance requirements.
  • Leads design reviews and technical workshops to uplevel engineering practices across the organization.
  • Contributes to strategic planning for data platform evolution and modernization initiatives.



Requirements

  • Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in data engineering, with a strong emphasis on designing and implementing cloud-based solutions.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL , with hands-on experience in both relational (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, Snowflake) and NoSQL (e.g., MongoDB, DynamoDB) databases.
  • Extensive experience architecting and operating data platforms on AWS and Azure; relevant cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Data Analytics, Azure Data Engineer Associate) strongly preferred.
  • Deep knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ETL/ELT processes, data modeling , and enterprise data governance frameworks.

  • Exceptional problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and proactively in fast-paced settings.

Benefits

  • Meal Allowance R$ 50.00 per day

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work closely with engineering, IT, and product teams to integrate compliance requirements into SaaS product development and operations
  • Training and Awareness : Conduct training sessions for employees on SOC 2 compliance requirements and best practices for maintaining a secure SaaS environment
  • Reporting and Metrics : Use Vanta's reporting features to track compliance metrics, generate reports, and communicate the company's security posture to internal stakeholders and external clients
  • Stay Updated : Keep abreast of evolving compliance frameworks, security standards, and Vanta platform updates to ensure alignment with industry best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience in compliance, information security, or risk management, with a focus on SOC 2 compliance in a SaaS environment

title: Franchise Business Consultant - LATAM
description:
The Franchise Business Consultant – LATAM supports Master Franchise and Direct Franchise partners across Latin America by providing operational guidance, financial coaching, and training to drive performance while ensuring alignment with Gold’s Gym global standards. This role requires fluency in Portuguese and English and proficiency in Spanish to effectively collaborate across diverse markets in the region. The FBC conducts regular market visits, virtual consultations, and leads both in-person and online training sessions. This is a remote role based out of the Brasil. Frequent travel throughout Latin America—up to 50% or more—is required.


Responsibilities:


Franchise Support & Coaching

  • Serve as the primary operational liaison for Master Franchise and Direct Franchise owners, offering consultative support on day-to-day operations, financial performance, leadership development, and member experience.
  • Build strong, collaborative relationships across culturally and linguistically diverse markets, ensuring business strategies align with Gold’s Gym standards while adapting to local market needs.
  • Conduct regular check-ins and annual in-person site visits with each franchise location in the assigned LATAM territory.
  • Provide guidance and resources to drive operational excellence and regional growth.
  • Leverage KPI benchmarks, and digital platforms to monitor and support franchise performance.


Training & Leadership Development

  • Develop and deliver in-person and virtual training sessions in Portuguese (and Spanish where applicable) for franchisees and their teams, focusing on operational efficiency, member experience, and profitability.
  • Facilitate webinars, learning sessions, and peer collaboration forums to promote continuous learning and knowledge sharing in the LATAM market.
  • Lead onboarding programs for new franchisees and gym leaders, providing a strong foundation in Gold’s Gym systems, standards, and growth strategies.
  • Champion the rollout of corporate initiatives, tools, and new programs, ensuring cultural adaptation and consistent adoption across locations.


Operational Evaluations & Brand Standards

  • Perform standardized gym evaluations, operational audits, and brand assessments.
  • Ensure all LATAM locations remain compliant with system standards, brand guidelines, and operational policies.


Strategic Business & Financial Planning

  • Review and interpret financial reports (P&Ls, balance sheets, KPIs) to identify trends and coach franchisees on strategies for profitability and operational improvement.
  • Assist with strategic planning, forecasting, and staff planning tailored to the LATAM region.


Market Insights & System Collaboration

  • Conduct annual market reviews and monitor competitive activity in each territory.
  • Share benchmarking data, performance insights, and market intelligence with both franchisees and internal teams.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, technology, and development teams to align LATAM field strategies with broader corporate objectives.


Skills & Qualifications

  • Fluency in Portuguese, English and Spanish required.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in franchise operations, business consulting, or multi-unit fitness/hospitality management.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Exercise Science, or a related field preferred.
  • Proven ability to lead both in-person and virtual training programs in multiple languages.
  • Strong knowledge of fitness industry operations, financial drivers, and customer experience best practices.
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and coaching skills, with a high degree of cultural intelligence.
  • Basic knowledge of gym technology platforms is a plus.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% or more across Latin America and Caribbean, including overnight travel and weekends when necessary.


Preferred Attributes

  • Passion for fitness, health, and wellness.
  • Experience supporting international franchise or multi-unit business models, particularly in Latin America.
  • Strong presence and confidence when leading groups and delivering training in culturally diverse environments.
  • High level of business acumen, adaptability, and emotional intelligence.
  • Familiarity with Gold’s Gym tools, systems, or service providers.

title: Electrical Supervisor
description:
Offshore Electrical Supervisor - Drillship in Brazil - Local payroll


* Offshore Experience working on a drillship or Semi is essential *


Overview


We are seeking an experienced and proactive Electrical Supervisor to oversee all electrical systems and operations onboard a drillship.

In this role, you will ensure high operational efficiency, compliance with safety standards, and support smooth offshore drilling activities. This role is critical to ensuring the continued success of our offshore operations while fostering an inclusive, safety-first work environment.

This position offers an exciting opportunity to work in a dynamic and diverse offshore environment. Candidates with leadership capabilities, technical expertise, and experience in drilling operations are encouraged to apply.


Responsibilities

  • Supervise the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of onboard electrical systems, including complex drilling and offshore equipment.
  • Ensure compliance with all safety regulations, electrical codes, and offshore operation standards.
  • Coordinate with the drilling and mechanical teams to ensure seamless integration of electrical systems in daily operations.
  • Develop, review, and update maintenance schedules for electrical equipment and systems.
  • Conduct routine inspections and testing of all electrical systems to identify and address potential hazards or failures.
  • Provide leadership, guidance, and training to a diverse team of electricians and support crew members.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to resolve technical challenges and implement long-term solutions for system efficiency.
  • Maintain accurate records of electrical works, inspections, breakdowns, and necessary upgrades for equipment.
  • Contribute to the safety culture on the drillship by adhering to and promoting a safe work environment, including performing safety audits and toolbox talks.
  • Work within teams to prepare for emergencies and respond promptly to electrical system failures or incidents.


Experience :

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in a supervisor role, preferably on a drillship or semi-submersible
  • Strong understanding of marine electrical systems, offshore drilling equipment, and high-voltage systems.
  • Technical Skills : Proficiency in troubleshooting electrical systems, managing control panels, and handling PLC systems.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of international offshore standards, electrical codes, and safety regulations.
  • Proven ability to lead and work with diverse teams in high-pressure and dynamic environments.
  • Physical fitness to work in an offshore setting, with appropriate certifications (e.g., BOSIET, HUET, or OGUK Medical Certificate).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to ensure effective collaboration across teams.


Day-to-day

  • Inspect, maintain, and repair electrical systems to ensure uninterrupted operations.
  • Oversee electrical team members, assigning tasks and providing technical guidance as needed.
  • Communicate with the drilling and operations team to address any immediate power or system issues affecting performance.
  • Monitor and report electrical maintenance progress to onboard management and onshore support teams.
  • Document all findings during inspections and repairs, updating maintenance logs accordingly.
  • Provide mentorship to less-experienced team members, fostering an inclusive and supportive learning environment.

title: Cloud Native Developer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Senior Cloud Native Developer to join our growing team. We are proud to deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.

This is a full-time, remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only), offering the opportunity to collaborate directly with our US-based client and international development teams.


About the role:


As a Senior Cloud Native Developer , you will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining scalable, cloud-native applications using Azure and .NET technologies . You will collaborate with product owners, architects, and cross-functional teams to implement high-quality software solutions that follow modern engineering practices.

This role is ideal for someone with deep technical expertise in Azure cloud services , microservices , and backend development , combined with strong problem-solving abilities and a collaborative mindset.


Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and maintain cloud-native applications using Azure services , .NET Core , and C# .
  • Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions to ensure smooth and automated deployments.
  • Define and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) using Pulumi .
  • Develop microservices and event-driven architectures leveraging Azure Functions , Azure Service Bus , and Cosmos DB .
  • Build and optimize RESTful APIs , ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability.
  • Collaborate closely with architects, QA, and product teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Apply best practices for monitoring , logging , and application performance management .
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.


Required Qualifications:


  • Strong experience in software development with .NET Core and C# .
  • Strong knowledge of Azure cloud services , including Azure Functions , Service Bus , and Cosmos DB .
  • Experience with microservices architecture and event-driven systems .
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD concepts , including hands-on experience with GitHub Actions or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Pulumi , Terraform , or similar frameworks.
  • Experience building and managing containers (Docker) and working with container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes).
  • Strong understanding of software design principles , clean code , and best engineering practices .
  • Excellent communication skills in English and ability to work collaboratively in distributed, cross-functional teams.


Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have):


  • Experience with Kafka or similar event streaming platforms.
  • Familiarity with Application Insights , Grafana , or other monitoring tools.
  • Understanding of MuleSoft or similar integration platforms.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
